source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_SELECT_SRC
(
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_SELECT_SRC
(
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.ID
				,CC.LEGAL_ENTITY
				,CC.ROLES
				,CC.FULL_NAME
				,CC.SHORT_NAME
				,CC.COUNTRY
				,CC.PARENT
				,CC.PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,CC.COMMENT
				,CC.STATUS
				,CC.EXTERNAL_REF
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_GROUP_SRC
(
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BNK_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME,5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1



INSERT INTO EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION
(
                 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST
				,BNK_CODE
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME 
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				 ID
				,LEGAL_ENTITY
				,ROLES
				,FULL_NAME
				,SHORT_NAME
				,COUNTRY
				,PARENT
				,PARENT_SHORT_NAME
				,COMMENT
				,STATUS
				,EXTERNAL_REF
				,FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'TRY'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRY_LEGALENTITYEXCLUSION_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
